name: NESSiE
description: NESSiE is a lightweight benchmark designed to identify safety-relevant failures in large language models (LLMs) through minimal test cases of information and access security. It serves as a necessary sanity check for language model safety, revealing failures even in low-complexity tasks and highlighting the trade-off between helpfulness and safety in model behavior.
reputation: A niche but useful safety benchmark that is mainly used by researchers as a sanity check for security-related failure modes rather than as a broad community leaderboard.
notes: Designed as a necessary but not sufficient safety check; even state-of-the-art LLMs do not reach 100% on NESSiE.
